samples.summary: Root-relative resolution only covered end-to-end on the chart path; image/media and presentation→slide-list call sites of resolveRelsTarget have no integration coverage
samples.evidence: resolveRelsTarget has 7 call sites (slide.ts:158,222; chart.ts:258; image.ts:78; index.ts:261,326,350,390 per grep). The new tests cover the helper directly (rels.test.ts:27-33) and one end-to-end path (chart-integration.test.ts:24). No test exercises a root-relative `Target="/ppt/media/image1.png"` through importPptx, nor a root-relative slide/layout/master target from presentation.xml.rels — I grepped for `/ppt/` across packages/slides tests and only found content-types fixture strings and the new rels/chart tests. Impact is contained because the shared helper is unit-tested and any residual bug in a caller (e.g. a caller that pre-strips or re-prefixes) would show as a dropped image/slide, not data corruption.

samples.summary: First it.each case ('../charts/chart1.xml') performs an identity string replace, so the zip rewrite adds no coverage over the original test
samples.evidence: chart-integration.test.ts:24-36 replaces `Target="../charts/chart1.xml"` with the same value for the first parameter, so the loadAsync/generateAsync round-trip is pure ceremony for that case. It is a harmless control case, but the added zip mutation machinery only carries signal for the '/ppt/charts/chart1.xml' parameter.
